cues: Come, my guest, says the guide; today I am to show you some eyes.

He takes the tourist up Chobhar hill, past the gorge of the Manjushri legend, past a village artist's drawing of birds and a temple of no named religion, to the Adinath temple, where Shiva and the Buddha stand together and children play.
The tourist would call it living tolerance.
The guide agrees, but will not stop there.
He climbs on, to a farmer's family who pay half their harvest to a landlord in the city.
